messages.subject: Error: cannot open the connection
parts:
Hi, 

This is my first time deploy my ShinyApp in shinyapp.io so I encountered couple problems I am trying to figure out. 

One issue I have now is that: I created a www folder in my local MyshinyApp folder, then put data.csv file and help.pdf files in this folder. After deployApp() I am trying to connect these two files using the link: https://ningningchen.shinyapps.io/MyshinyApp/data.csv and https://ningningchen.shinyapps.io/MyshinyApp/help.pdf (https://ningningchen.shinyapps.io/MyshinyApp is my shiny app link). However, it gives me the error: cannot open the connection. It seems like these two links/files do not exist. I am new to this shinyapp.io server and I don't know what else i need to do to make it work. 

Thanks,
Ningning
